# Issue #193 runner landing proof

These are fabricated implementation-proof fixtures for the reviewed version 5
runner. They demonstrate the revised acceptance publication surface without
executing or claiming any acceptance replicate. The version 5 manifest is
revealed from the merged protocol revision, but no acceptance task has run.
Regenerate them with:

```sh
Rscript scripts/render-issue-193-runner-proof.R
```

The retained [manifest summary](manifest-summary.txt) records the reviewed
protocol revision and a fixture runner identity, plus the deterministic
manifest digest, requested task count, and revealed seed range. The fixture
identity is not a merged runner revision. This is an execution-boundary proof,
not an acceptance result.
